subcmd.healthcheck: Probe a ChatCLI server's gRPC health (exit 0 when serving); the image HEALTHCHECK
healthcheck.failed: %s did not answer the health check: %v
healthcheck.no_san: the server certificate names no DNS name or IP address; pass -tls-server-name
healthcheck.mtls_needs_client_cert: the server requires client certificates: set CHATCLI_TLS_CLIENT_CERT and CHATCLI_TLS_CLIENT_KEY to a pair its CA issued (the same pair chatcli connect uses)
healthcheck.flag.addr: server address (default: the local server's port and bind)
healthcheck.flag.service: service to ask about; empty means the whole server
healthcheck.flag.timeout: how long to wait for the answer
healthcheck.flag.tls_cert: certificate the server serves; enables TLS and is the only one trusted (default: the local server's)
healthcheck.flag.tls_server_name: name to verify the server certificate by (default: its first DNS name or IP address)
healthcheck.flag.tls_client_cert: client certificate for a server that requires mTLS (default: CHATCLI_TLS_CLIENT_CERT)
